# AGENTS.md

Keep unrelated edits already in the working tree. An `AGENTS.md` in a subdirectory adds rules for that subtree.

[docs/AGENTS.md](docs/AGENTS.md) says where each kind of document goes and how specs are built.

## Specs

The paths below each belong to exactly one spec page. Code the table does not list has no page and needs none. A page under a node, such as `cli/shot`, owns its paths ahead of the node's own page `cli`.

<!-- subsystem-map:start — generated by `python3 scripts/verify_subsystem_pages.py --map`; do not edit -->
| Paths | Page |
|---|---|
<!-- subsystem-map:end -->

- Before you edit a file in the table, read the page that owns it, and only that page. The most specific path wins: a file over a glob, a glob over a directory, a deeper directory over its parent. Reading code needs no page.
- Before a change that crosses pages, read the `architecture.md` of the smallest node that holds them all; at the top that is [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md).
- If your edit makes a statement on a page you read false, correct the statement in the same change; do not re-check the rest of the page.
- End your final report with `Docs:` naming those pages, each `updated` or `unchanged`. Omit the line when you edited no file in the table.
- Formatting-only, comment-only, test-only, and dependency-version edits need no page.

## Checks

- Run the smallest set of checks that covers the change; skip them when nothing they cover changed.
- Report only the commands you ran and their actual results. Report a check that has not run as pending, and read a failure before blaming the change or the environment.

## Conventions

- Tests record intended behavior. When behavior changes on purpose, change its tests with it and say why in the change description.
- Generated files such as catalogs, snapshots, and fixtures follow their source: edit the source, then regenerate.
- Files end with exactly one trailing newline.
- Comments and docs state what a reader needs (behavior, failure, timing, ownership, safe use) in direct, concrete terms. They do not narrate control flow or reasoning, or keep review history.
